pr.body:
## Summary
Promote the reviewed, gate-approved history from `staging` to the default branch `main`. Every commit on staging already passed the compliance gate and was archived; this promotion releases the policy pack, the processing-integrity app, the privacy app, and the governance artifacts to production so the system description and the criteria verifier evaluate the released branch. No new code — a promotion of already-approved changes.

## Tickets
| Ticket | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| #24 | Promote staging → production (main) | In Progress |
